search_leads.title: Search leads
search_leads.description: Search personal and commercial leads by status, producer, source, name, email, phone, pipeline and stage, created and sold dates and last activity, a page at a time.

location.description: Agency location code to search within.

creator.description: Id of the user who created the lead.

last_activity_earliest_date.description: Last activity on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

last_activity_latest_date.description: Last activity on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

create_lead.title: Create a personal lead
create_lead.description: Create a personal lines lead with contact details, address, pipeline and stage, source, producer and CSR, X-date and custom fields.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline to put the lead in; see list_pipelines_and_stages.

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage to put the lead in.

x_date.description: X-date: when the prospect's current policy renews.

assignment_group_id.description: Assignment group that distributes the lead.

assign_to.description: Employee id of the producer the lead is assigned to; see list_employees.

agency_number.description: Agency number the lead belongs to.

output.description: {message, id, result}; id is the new lead.

create_commercial_lead.title: Create a commercial lead
create_commercial_lead.description: Create a commercial lines lead: the contact fields of a personal lead plus the business name, DBA, FEIN, entity, classification, employees, revenue and payroll.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline to put the lead in; see list_pipelines_and_stages.

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage to put the lead in.

x_date.description: X-date: when the prospect's current policy renews.

assignment_group_id.description: Assignment group that distributes the lead.

assign_to.description: Employee id of the producer the lead is assigned to; see list_employees.

agency_number.description: Agency number the lead belongs to.

output.description: {message, id, result}; id is the new lead.

get_lead.title: Get a lead
get_lead.description: Read a lead with contact details, status, pipeline stage, producer and CSR, dates, opportunities, quotes, premiums, tags, custom fields and, for commercial leads, business details.

update_lead.title: Update a lead
update_lead.description: Change a personal lead's contact details, address, pipeline stage, source, assignment, dates, tags or custom fields.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline to put the lead in; see list_pipelines_and_stages.

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage to put the lead in.

x_date.description: X-date: when the prospect's current policy renews.

assignment_group_id.description: Assignment group that distributes the lead.

assign_to.description: Employee id of the producer the lead is assigned to; see list_employees.

agency_number.description: Agency number the lead belongs to.

update_commercial_lead.title: Update a commercial lead
update_commercial_lead.description: Change a commercial lead's contact and business details.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline to put the lead in; see list_pipelines_and_stages.

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage to put the lead in.

x_date.description: X-date: when the prospect's current policy renews.

assignment_group_id.description: Assignment group that distributes the lead.

assign_to.description: Employee id of the producer the lead is assigned to; see list_employees.

agency_number.description: Agency number the lead belongs to.

mark_lead_sold.title: Mark a lead sold
mark_lead_sold.description: Record a lead's sale with the products sold -- carrier, product line, premium, items, dates and policy number -- optionally keeping the lead open. This moves it to sold and affects producer commission reporting.

sold_products.description: Products sold, each {carrierId or standardCarrierCode, productLineId or standardProductLineCode, premium, items, effectiveDate, expiryDate, soldDate, policyNumber, leadSourceId, locationId, departmentCode, groupCode, csrId, quoteId, isSold}.

keep_open.description: True to keep the lead open for more sales.

list_lead_opportunities.title: List a lead's opportunities
list_lead_opportunities.description: List the opportunities on a lead with carrier, product line, status, premium, items, custom fields and property addresses.

delete_lead_opportunity.title: Delete a lead opportunity
delete_lead_opportunity.description: Delete one opportunity from a lead; the lead itself stays.

list_lead_quotes.title: List a lead's quotes
list_lead_quotes.description: List the quotes on a lead with carrier, product, premium, whether sold, potential revenue and effective date.

delete_lead_quote.title: Delete a lead quote
delete_lead_quote.description: Delete one quote from a lead; the lead and its other quotes stay.

list_lead_notes.title: List a lead's notes
list_lead_notes.description: List the notes and activity entries on a lead.

add_lead_note.title: Add a note to a lead
add_lead_note.description: Add a note to a lead's activity history.

search_customers.title: Search customers
search_customers.description: Search customers by name, email, phone, city and state, customer dates, lead source, policy type or product line, producer and status, a page at a time.

location.description: Agency location code to search within.

start_date.description: Became a customer on or after.

end_date.description: Became a customer on or before.

policy_type.description: Only customers with this policy type.

standard_product_line_code.description: Only customers with this standard product line.

get_customer.title: Get a customer
get_customer.description: Read a customer with contact details, custom fields, policies, notes, tasks, files and total premium.

update_customer.title: Update a customer
update_customer.description: Change a customer's contact details, address, business details, tags, producer, CSR or custom fields. Dates are MM/DD/YYYY.

biz_customer.description: 1 for a business customer, 0 for a personal one.

number_of_employees.description: Number of employees, for a business.

delete_customer.title: Delete a customer
delete_customer.description: Delete a customer record from AgencyZoom.

list_customer_policies.title: List a customer's policies
list_customer_policies.description: List the policies recorded in AgencyZoom for a customer: type, carrier, number, premium, dates, producer and CSR.

list_customer_ams_policies.title: List a customer's AMS policies
list_customer_ams_policies.description: List a customer's policies as synced from the agency management system.

create_policy.title: Create a policy
create_policy.description: Record a policy on a customer: insured, carrier, policy type, number, premium and broker fee, sold, effective and expiry dates, producer, CSR and prior policy.

standard_carrier_code.description: Standard carrier code, instead of carrierId.

standard_product_line_code.description: Standard product line code, instead of policyType.

meta.description: Extra metadata to store with the policy.

update_policy.title: Update a policy
update_policy.description: Change a policy's carrier, type, number, premium, dates, producer, CSR, prior policy or tags.

standard_carrier_code.description: Standard carrier code, instead of carrierId.

standard_product_line_code.description: Standard product line code, instead of policyType.

tag_policy.title: Tag a policy
tag_policy.description: Set a policy's tags, identifying it by AgencyZoom policy id or AMS policy id.

policy_id.description: AgencyZoom policy id; or give amsPolicyId.

ams_policy_id.description: Agency management system policy id, instead of policyId.

create_opportunity.title: Create an opportunity
create_opportunity.description: Add a sales opportunity to a lead: carrier and product line, items, premium, current expiry, producer, custom fields and the property location.

standard_carrier_code.description: Standard carrier code, instead of carrierId.

product_line_id.description: Product line (policy type) id; or give standardProductLineCode.

standard_product_line_code.description: Standard product line code, instead of productLineId.

items.description: Number of items insured, e.g. vehicles.

customer_referral_id.description: Lead id the opportunity belongs to.

property.description: Property location: {address1, address2, city, state, zip, country, useMailingAddressAsLocation (1 or 0)}.

output.description: {message, id, result}; id is the new opportunity.

get_opportunity.title: Get an opportunity
get_opportunity.description: Read an opportunity's carrier, product line, status, premium, items, custom fields and property address.

update_opportunity.title: Update an opportunity
update_opportunity.description: Change an opportunity's carrier, product line, items, premium, expiry, producer, custom fields or property.

standard_carrier_code.description: Standard carrier code, instead of carrierId.

product_line_id.description: Product line (policy type) id; or give standardProductLineCode.

standard_product_line_code.description: Standard product line code, instead of productLineId.

items.description: Number of items insured, e.g. vehicles.

property.description: Property location: {address1, address2, city, state, zip, country, useMailingAddressAsLocation (1 or 0)}.

delete_opportunity.title: Delete an opportunity
delete_opportunity.description: Delete an opportunity with its links to drivers and vehicles.

list_opportunity_drivers.title: List an opportunity's drivers
list_opportunity_drivers.description: List the drivers on an auto opportunity with licence and personal details.

add_opportunity_driver.title: Add a driver
add_opportunity_driver.description: Add a driver to an auto opportunity, optionally creating a contact from them.

gender.description: Gender code, e.g. M or F.

relationship.description: Relationship to the insured, e.g. IN for the insured.

create_contact.description: True to also create a contact from the driver.

output.description: {message, id, result}; id is the new driver.

link_opportunity_driver.title: Link a driver
link_opportunity_driver.description: Attach an existing driver to an opportunity.

unlink_opportunity_driver.title: Unlink a driver
unlink_opportunity_driver.description: Detach a driver from an opportunity without deleting the driver.

list_opportunity_vehicles.title: List an opportunity's vehicles
list_opportunity_vehicles.description: List the vehicles on an auto opportunity with VIN, year, make, model and ownership.

add_opportunity_vehicle.title: Add a vehicle
add_opportunity_vehicle.description: Add a vehicle to an auto opportunity by VIN, year, make, model and ownership.

output.description: {message, id, result}; id is the new vehicle.

link_opportunity_vehicle.title: Link a vehicle
link_opportunity_vehicle.description: Attach an existing vehicle to an opportunity.

unlink_opportunity_vehicle.title: Unlink a vehicle
unlink_opportunity_vehicle.description: Detach a vehicle from an opportunity without deleting the vehicle.

search_email_threads.title: Search email threads
search_email_threads.description: Search the agency's synced email threads by text, sender, agent, status, recent activity and account.

location.description: Agency location code to search within.

last_date_utc.description: Only threads with activity after this UTC date.

is_include_empty_threads.description: True to include threads with no messages.

get_email_thread.title: Get an email thread
get_email_thread.description: Read the messages in an email thread with senders, recipients, body and attachments, a page at a time.

location.description: Agency location code to search within.

list_pipelines.title: List pipelines
list_pipelines.description: List the agency's sales and service pipelines.

list_pipelines_and_stages.title: List pipelines and stages
list_pipelines_and_stages.description: List every pipeline with its stages, sequence and status -- the ids lead creation and updates take.

list_product_categories.title: List policy categories
list_product_categories.description: List the product categories (policy categories) the agency uses.

list_product_lines.title: List policy types
list_product_lines.description: List the product lines (policy types) with their category and standard product line code.

list_employees.title: List employees
list_employees.description: List the agency's employees with email, phone and whether each is a producer, active or an owner -- the ids for assignTo, agentId and csrId.

list_carriers.title: List carriers
list_carriers.description: List the insurance carriers the agency works with and their standard carrier codes.

list_custom_fields.title: List custom fields
list_custom_fields.description: List the custom field definitions -- name, label, data type, options and which records and sections they appear on.

update_my_profile.title: Update my profile
update_my_profile.description: Change the signed-in user's name, email or phone.
